historicalAnchors.caveat: The old anchor map contains simulation, audio sample index and AudioContext time, but no local wall/performance timestamp. The audio-per-wall estimate applies the capture-wide simulation/wall ratio to this local interval.

currentMatchedPollInterval.caveat: Current interval uses same-callback main-thread performance, simulation and AudioContext poll values; start was selected nearest to the old anchor simulation time, then the end nearest to eight seconds of wall time.

layerSleepEvidence.method: For each processor diagnostic, select nearest main-thread poll only if topologyGeneration matches; old material is treated fully buried only when exposedCellCount=0 and buriedCellCount>0.

processorOutput.interpretation: clipped counts worklet mixed-signal threshold crossings before its existing bounded output mapping; this capture has no PCM tap and therefore does not verify final captured-sample clipping.

processorValidation.clippedCounterMeaning: pre-limiter threshold crossing counter; not captured PCM clipping
